english: Beauty...?! Calling ME a beauty, huh?!
Hey. You saying I'm a beauty?
You bastard!\fYou know your stuff! I like you!
Since you're here, I'll tell you my life story.
Oh... Too bad. Well, call me if there's a fire.
Should be fine. Must've absorbed the life energy.
Thank you. Did you bring an umbrella today?
Where would THAT rain down?! Give me a location!
I said, it's not like that!
Force it out and Hijikata dies.
Sure it's okay? What about life energy?
I don't mind, but is something wrong?
Oh, no! Go to the hospital and have it removed!
Parasites need removing quickly! Especially anisakis. Dangerous!
Shall I take you to the vet?
Maybe we've talked to ten beauties now?
Shouldn't we go back where we started?
Oh! Because he talked to Otose!
No, it's true! Talk to a woman who isn't beautiful, and he dies!
I'll kill the lot of you!
BAD DOESN'T BEGIN TO COVER IT, BASTARD!
An ugly old lady, at that.
Crap! Toshi dies with the alien inside him!
I refuse to accept a game over like this!
Seems the instant game over for non-beauties is real.
Oh, the three Shinsengumi. Need something?
What do you mean? I haven't done anything!
How rude! Suffer horribly and DIE!
Needed a beauty's help to survive... Too late now.
Hijikata. I'll put you out of your misery.
Not collecting them. Just need to talk.
Had to go talking to an old lady...
What?! What are you doing with ten beauties?
I could be one of those ten, you know.
Toshi's dying! A desperate, life-or-death crisis!
So this monster gets sorted into the not-beautiful category, huh.
Oh, Shinsengumi. Fancy meeting you here.
Don't talk about me like garbage!
Beauties, huh... If drag queens will do, I know a couple.
Ugh... It hurts... Let me sleep...
Hijikata. Is it safe talking to a drag queen?
Dying from talking to a drag queen? Hijikata fans nationwide might riot.
There's a beauty right in front of you!
I don't like jokes either!\fJokes... Jordan... Michael Jordan... Michael... Michael!\fMichael! That bastard! Called me a cyborg!
Must've talked to a woman who isn't beautiful.
If the alien inside dies, Toshi dies too!
If a drag queen will do, I'm right here.
Gin Tama... Why've you got one?
I see... I'll gladly take it, then.
Coming out of Hijikata's body, maybe?
Thank you! Thanks to you, I'm full of energy!
Found it nearby. Was going to take it home as a souvenir of Earth...\fBut life energy and your kindness are the best souvenirs.
Beauties... What type do you like?
Heard there's a beauty around here. Know her?
TV station, maybe? Ask someone who knows more than me.
An idol? Alien can't complain about that.
What can I say? Ask someone else.
Yamazaki! Good timing. Got a question.
I see... Can't just leave that alone...
By the way, know any beauties?
Vice-Chief! Glad the chief's here too!
Hmm... Can't think of anyone on the spot.
This is really gonna kill Toshi!
I said, a beauty. Dressed like a shrine maiden. You'll know her.
A beauty... Did see one, come to think of it.
Long-haired girl, dressed like a shrine maiden.
I see. That's why she was with Oryo.
Ane and Oryo work at the same club.
Only know she's meant to be pretty...
Dressed like a shrine maiden? Maybe Ane's little sister?
Hey. This the underground Gin Tama battle venue?
It's fine, Kondo. I'll go alone.
Leave it to me. You and Sougo might just slow me down.
Not a kid. Leave him be... Well, I'm off.
How dare you! ...Huh? Wait. Where's Sougo...?
Yeah. Failed last time. Won't happen again.
Leave him alone... Anyway, I'm going in.
Hey... This pass gets me inside, right?
Oh, the guard. Show him the pass, right?
